purpose: Shared exact nearest-even power-of-two rounding and int16 saturation; multiplier is upstream and not claimed here
input: signed int64 product, unsigned shift 0..62, opaque tag16, valid
pipeline: nine globally enabled register stages; II one enabled clock; eight enabled rising-edge intervals from acceptance to output
stall: i_advance must be low whenever the enclosing pipeline cannot accept its held output; all stages freeze
fault: shift63 or INT64_MIN: valid tagged fault, output data unspecified and must not be published
reset: asynchronous active-low clears all valid and data state, cancels every in-flight token
rounding: abs quotient and remainder, increment above half or tie with odd quotient; restore sign then saturate int16
